name: Liliana Malcatras
source: Liliana Malcatras is an adoptive daughter and Special Maid (servant and bodyguard) of Lady Francesca Malcatras. She has the magic ability "Dual Attraction" which allows her to touch two targets (objects or lifeforms) and telekinetically draw them together or repel them from eachother.
